llm_generated_explanation.mechanism:
CYP2D6 is a hepatic cytochrome P450 enzyme responsible for metabolising a large share of commonly used drugs. CYP2D6 is unusually variable: as well as single-nucleotide variants that alter or abolish activity, the gene is subject to **whole-gene deletions and duplications**, so copy number differs between people. Activity is conventionally summarised as an activity score derived from both alleles.

Source: Annotation of CPIC Guideline for codeine and CYP2D6 — Crews KR et al. Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium Guideline for CYP2D6, OPRM1, and COMT Genotypes and Select Opioid Therapy. Clin Pharmacol Ther (2021). PMID: 33387367

Input quality was not established for required positions marked FILTER=. in: CYP2C19 (16), CYP2C9 (17), CYP2D6 (67), DPYD (31), NUDT15 (5), SLCO1B1 (20), TPMT (9). These complete genotypes were retained because the VCF does not explicitly mark them as failed and this application does not invent assay-independent DP/GQ/QUAL thresholds. Confirm the upstream caller's quality policy before relying on them.

Every gene (7 of 7) was declined, at 19–57% position coverage. That pattern is a property of the FILE, not of 7 separate genes — and it has two common causes.

This looks like a research-format or SNP-array export.

• A research VCF (1000 Genomes, gnomAD, most sequencing pipelines) is POLYMORPHIC-FILTERED: it lists only positions where someone differed from the reference. The positions that matched are simply absent, and absent is indistinguishable from never-tested.
• A consumer export (23andMe, AncestryDNA) is a GENOTYPING ARRAY, not sequencing. It reports a few hundred thousand chosen positions across the whole genome, which is not the same as reporting every position one gene needs.

Neither is a bad file. Both are the wrong shape for this question. What works is a clinical pharmacogenomic panel, or a sequencing pipeline re-run to emit every position including the reference matches. The input requirements page lists the specific sources.

DPYD: 8 of 28 positions that could indicate reduced function carry an explicit genotype in this VCF. The gene met its 20% coverage minimum (37%), but percentage is a proxy: a file can clear it while omitting every position capable of showing a variant. Reported as Unknown rather than assuming the missing positions match the reference — which is what would make a reduced-function result read as normal.
